details: Solana has introduced an AI-powered Playground that enables developers to write, edit, and deploy blockchain programs directly from their browsers, streamlining dApp development with an integrated AI agent.
title: Solana Launches AI-Powered Playground for Blockchain Devs

details: Coinbase-backed Ethereum layer-2 Base is making quantum security a key priority for 2027. Its upcoming Everest upgrade will introduce new transaction types to lay the groundwork for quantum-secure wallets, responding to regulator warnings about future threats.
title: Base Prioritizes Quantum Security for 2027, Everest Upgrade Lays Groundwork

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) approved a plan to allow banks to use tokenized securities issued on EU-licensed distributed ledger platforms as collateral for central bank loans, effective June 2027, boosting institutional adoption.
title: ECB Expands Eligible Collateral to Include Tokenized Securities

details: USDT's supply across Ethereum and TRON networks has fallen by $8.1 billion over 60 days, marking its sharpest contraction since August 2022. This comes as Bitcoin struggles near $60,000, and CryptoQuant suggests renewed USDT growth is crucial for a sustainable BTC recovery.
title: Tether (USDT) Supply Shrinks $8.1B, Largest Contraction Since 2022

details: Hong Kong-based cryptocurrency trading and market-making firm Auros has reportedly begun winding down its operations after seven years. The firm previously survived the FTX collapse but sources indicate undisclosed reasons for the current closure, impacting crypto liquidity.
title: Hong Kong Crypto Market Maker Auros Reportedly Winding Down

details: A long-time Ethereum investor from the 2014 ICO has liquidated their remaining 45,000 ETH for approximately $75.35 million at $1,674 per ETH. This marks the complete exit of a position that generated over $87 million from an initial $31,000 investment.
title: Early Ethereum Whale Sells Last 45,000 ETH for $75 Million

details: The crypto market experienced a Thanksgiving-day lull, with attention now on Friday's $7 billion Bitcoin options expiry on Deribit. Mixed derivatives sentiment and extreme pessimism suggest potential volatility or a short-covering rally.
title: Crypto Market Pauses for Thanksgiving Ahead of $7 Billion BTC Options Expiry

details: Ripple partnered with Türkiye's Yapı Kredi to support its digital asset business, expanding its global reach. Simultaneously, the XRP Ledger's proposed XLS-66 lending protocol amendment is one vote away from activation. XRP saw a rebound in the last 24 hours.
title: Ripple Expands in Türkiye, XRP Ledger Lending Upgrade Nears

details: A Bank of Japan executive has called for stricter regulations on stablecoin reserves and expressed warnings regarding the inherent risks associated with tokenization within the financial system, signaling a cautious approach from central banks.
title: Bank of Japan Exec Warns on Stablecoin Regulation, Tokenization

details: Japanese financial giants SBI and SMFG have launched "SBI Solana Global," a joint venture on Solana to develop stablecoin payment infrastructure and explore tokenization of financial assets.
title: Japan's SBI, SMFG Launch Solana Venture for Stablecoins, Tokenization

details: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) has introduced a new tokenized debt platform, enabling 24-hour settlement for debt issuance, interest payments, and repayment at maturity, advancing digital asset infrastructure.
title: Hong Kong Launches Tokenized Debt Platform with 24-Hour Settlement

details: Hyperliquid (HYPE) fell over 8% after Abraxas Capital's withdrawal, contributing to broader altcoin losses as Bitcoin's price slipped below $59,000, exacerbated by US Bitcoin ETF outflows.
title: Hyperliquid Leads Altcoin Losses as Bitcoin Drops Below $59K

details: US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have registered $5.39 billion in net outflows for November, a record monthly total that indicates sustained institutional selling pressure in the crypto market.
title: US Spot Bitcoin ETFs See $5.39 Billion Net Outflows in November
